sloka: सर्वमद्यैव यूपाक्ष हरिसैन्यं सलक्ष्मणम् ।राघवं च रणे हत्वा पश्चाद्द्रक्ष्यामि रावणम् ।। ६.६०.८० ।।।।
transliteration: sarvamadyaiva yūpākṣa harisainyaṁ salakṣmaṇam ।rāghavaṁ ca raṇe hatvā paścāddrakṣyāmi rāvaṇam ।। 6.60.80 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the words of the reply of Kumbhakarna, filled with arrogance and pride, Mahodara, chief of the army, submitted with folded hands and said.
